name: Downer Gyaruko-chan to Shippori Onsen Ryokou ~H Shimakuri Yonpaku Itsuka no Tabi~
original_name: ダウナーギャル子ちゃんとしっぽり温泉旅行  ～Hしまくり四泊五日の旅～
source:
My name is Kunisaki Juuichi. I attend Yamagata Academy. Because I'm serious and a top student, everyone calls me ‘Sensei’.

My motto is to get along with everyone and enjoy school life to the fullest, but actually, I have a secret...! There's a girl I'm interested in. She's Sumine Masuzu from my class, known to everyone as ‘Suu-chan’.


She's a gal, but quiet and a bit down. Apparently, she doesn't study much and is in danger of failing a year. Her house happens to be in the same direction as mine. Today, she invited me to walk home together, but...

“Congratulations! You won the hot spring trip lottery!”

What?! Suu-chan hit the grand prize in the lottery we drew on the way home!? To my astonished look, she said.

“Sensei, wanna come with me?”

My heart's racing nonstop from this invitation from the girl I'm interested in! When I hesitated, saying it's impossible, Suu-chan pressed on.

“If it's with you, Sensei... maybe I could study?”

“And if you come... I'll take your virginity♪”

That line was too tempting—I nodded in agreement... No prep possible, certain to go off the rails. And... kinda moved. A four-night, five-day hot spring trip filled with shock and healing begins...!

[From [url=https://erotica.amusecraft.com/onsen03/]official site[/url]]
translation:
我的名字是国东十三一。我就读于山形学园。因为我很认真，而且是一名尖子生，所以大家都叫我“老师”。

我的座右铭是与大家和睦相处，尽情享受学校生活，但实际上，我有一个秘密……！我有一个很感兴趣的女孩。她是我们班的增铃须峰，大家都称呼她为“Suu-chan”。


她是个女孩，但很安静，有点低落。显然，她学习不多，有一年不及格的危险。她家正好和我家在同一个方向。今天，她邀请我一起步行回家，但是……

“恭喜你中奖了温泉之旅抽奖！”

什么？！回家路上抽奖，小秀中了大奖！？“对我惊讶的表情，”她说道。

“老师，要跟我一起去吗？”

收到我感兴趣的女孩的邀请，我的心跳得不停！当我犹豫着说不可能时，苏酱继续说道。

“如果有你的话，老师……也许我可以学习？”

“如果你来……我就夺走你的童贞♪”

这句话太诱人了——我点头同意……不可能做好准备，肯定会出轨。还有……有点感动。充满震撼与治愈的四晚五天温泉之旅开始了……！
